title: Robust Mora Header Detection & Workspace Tooling
summary: Fixes Mora count detection when nearby golden header text caused leading digits to be clipped, and introduces umbrella workspace scripts for running dev and test commands across all sub-projects.

changes.text: Mora Header Coin Isolation: upgraded Mora coin detection to use connected-component clustering on gold pixels, isolating the coin from nearby gold header text (such as 'Inventory' tabs) and preventing centroid drift that clipped leading digits.
Mora Crop Snippet: ensured enclosing bounding box cleanly frames both the golden coin icon and the entire digit sequence in the scan review modal.
Root Workspace Tooling: added root package.json to easily run dev, build, lint, test, and catalog sync commands across all submodules from the root directory.
